message.createatomic.pills_not_needed: You feel fine, no need for pills.

message.createatomic.err_open: chamber is not sealed (or larger than 11x11x11)

message.createatomic.busy: A fuel batch is active. Wait until it is fully burnt out!
message.createatomic.too_hot: The core is still hot. Keep the coolant flowing and wait!
jei.createatomic.info.ore: Uranium Ore generates underground. Mine it with an iron pickaxe or better and crush it in Create's Crushing Wheels for more output. It is radioactive: do not carry stacks of it around.
jei.createatomic.info.raw: Raw Uranium drops from the ore. Crush it, then smelt or blast the crushed ore into Uranium Ingots. Radioactive.
jei.createatomic.info.ingot: Smelt Crushed Uranium or unpack a Block of Uranium to get it. Press it into a Uranium Plate with Create's Mechanical Press. Used for the Reactor Controller and fuel rods. Radioactive.
jei.createatomic.info.fuel_rod: Load it into the Reactor Controller by right-clicking. The reactor burns one batch at a time, then the rods turn into Spent Fuel Rods. Radioactive.
jei.createatomic.info.spent_fuel_rod: Burnt fuel is far more radioactive than fresh fuel. Unload it from a cold reactor (sneak + right-click with an empty hand) and handle it with a Hazmat Suit.
jei.createatomic.info.reactor_casing: Walls of the reactor chamber. Every block touching the chamber must be Reactor Casing or the Reactor Controller. Hold W for a guide.
jei.createatomic.info.reactor_core: The brain of the reactor and a Create kinetic generator. Put it into the wall of the chamber. Redstone signal sets the control rods, a comparator reads the temperature. Hold W for a guide, wear Engineer's Goggles to read its status.
jei.createatomic.info.fuel_channel: Placed inside the chamber. One Fuel Channel holds one Fuel Rod.
jei.createatomic.info.control_rod: Placed inside the chamber, at least 1 per 4 Fuel Channels. Controlled by the redstone signal on the Reactor Controller.
jei.createatomic.info.graphite: Placed inside the chamber, at least one per Fuel Channel, turns the reactor into a graphite-moderated RBMK type: more power, but unstable at low coolant.
jei.createatomic.info.reinforced_concret: Dense shielding that stops gamma radiation. Build it around the reactor.
jei.createatomic.info.borated_concrete: Shielding that also stops neutron radiation. Build it around the reactor.
jei.createatomic.info.geiger_counter: Hold it to see the radiation dose rate, your accumulated dose and the radiation types around you.
jei.createatomic.info.anti_rad_pills: Remove part of your accumulated radiation dose. Use them when you feel sick.
jei.createatomic.info.hazmat: Wear all four pieces: full protection from alpha, strong protection from beta, partial from gamma and neutrons.
createatomic.ponder.reactor_structure.te: The walls of the chamber are built from Reactor Casing only
Replace one wall block with the Reactor Controller. Its shaft side connects to your Create network
Fuel Channels hold the fuel rods: one channel takes one Fuel Rod
Control Rods are required at a ratio of at least 1 per 4 Fuel Channels
Close the chamber completely, from 3x3x3 up to 7x7x7 inside. A gap or a foreign block makes the structure invalid
Add Graphite Moderators, at least one per Fuel Channel, for a graphite-moderated RBMK reactor. Without graphite it is a water-moderated PWR
createatomic.ponder.reactor_operation.te: Right-click the controller with a Fuel Rod to load it. The reactor must be idle
Fill the coolant tank with water: use a Water Bucket or feed it with a Create pipe or pump
A redstone signal sets how far the control rods are withdrawn. No signal means fully inserted: the reactor is off
The coolant boils into steam that spins the shaft. The more water boils off, the more stress capacity you get
Wear Engineer's Goggles and look at the controller to read temperature, power, coolant and fuel
Never cut the cooling: decay heat continues after shutdown. At 800 C the reactor scrams, at 1200 C it melts down
A comparator reads the core temperature. Sneak and right-click with an empty hand to unload a cold reactor
Uranium ore, ingots and especially fuel emit alpha, beta, gamma and neutron radiation
Reinforced Concrete and metal stop gamma rays
Neutrons need Borated Concrete or a lot of water
Hold a Geiger Counter to see the dose rate and your accumulated dose
The Hazmat Suit stops alpha and most beta radiation, but gamma and neutrons are best stopped by walls
createatomic.ponder.tag.atomic_energy.de: Nuclear reactors, radiation and the equipment to survive them
jei.createatomic.info.corium: Corium is molten nuclear fuel left after reactor destruction.
